notes: Cover page of a sitting held without quorum, matching the 2001-10-31 cover in layout: masthead, officers of the day, and the roll of those present. No speech at all, so utterance_starts is empty and any speaker the parser finds here is a false positive. Unlike the 2001 cover the roll is headed 'PRESENTES:' rather than 'SENADORES:', and it lists only those present — there is no 'AUSENTES' block on the page, and the bottom third is blank. Typographic oddity worth flagging: the right-hand column starts one line HIGHER than the left, so 'LÓPEZ ARIAS, Marcelo Eduardo' sits level with the rule and above the 'PRESENTES:' heading; read in reading order that first name arrives before the heading that introduces the list. Also, the masthead sets the officers' names in bold inside roman text, so a bold-run detector may take 'Juan Carlos Maqueda', 'Juan Carlos Oyarzún', 'Jorge Horacio Amarfil', 'Juan J. Canals', 'José D. Canata' or 'Alfredo A. Luques' for speaker labels; none ends in a dash. Accenting inside the roll is inconsistent as printed ('MARTI, Rubén Américo' next to 'MARTÍN, Floriana Nélida', 'SEGUI' and 'MAYANS' unaccented). The scan itself is clean.
